reviewed_by: Claude Code after independent subagent root-cause validation and scratch-Core reproduction
reason: Re-runnable http.invoke/v1 requests (provider non-streamed chat and Butler completions, goal start/pause/resume/cancel, unarchive, Butler provider session reservation) get a runtime_command_writes record that their route's first committed project write marks in the same transaction (execution_scope commit hook). Dead-owner reconcile and the lane-head path requeue a fenced owner's request that saved nothing, and settle saved ones with a precise result. Migration 0053 is additive. Selected: the new scope, orphan-recovery, API-worker and route regressions, runtime coordination, durable delivery, chat acceptance, migrations and runtime bundle compatibility; SQLite and PostgreSQL.
exclusions: No UI, native or Playwright layer: viewers see the same response once the request runs again. Worker death was exercised on a fake scratch Core (SIGKILL before and after the first write for each request kind). test_database_migration.py errors and hangs locally on SQLite on both main and this branch; it is left to CI's database-migrations job.
